description: This header file defines interfaces and types related to FSIO (likely 'File System I/O' or 'Functionality I/O') used for GPIO in the firmware. It declares functions for initializing, configuring, and obtaining values from FSIO components, and includes type definitions for 3D map structures.

methods.name: getEngineValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a specific engine action.

methods.name: setFsio
methods.description: Sets a FSIO pin based on an expression.

methods.name: setFsioExt
methods.description: Sets a FSIO pin with PWM frequency based on an expression.

methods.name: initFsioImpl
methods.description: Initializes the FSIO implementation with shared logging.

methods.name: runFsio
methods.description: Executes the main FSIO processing cycle.

methods.name: getFsioOutputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the output value for a specific FSIO index.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeFsioCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when FSIO-related configuration changes.
